description: Find a company or project behind Western Australian tenements, drillholes and WAMEX reports. A company groups its legal names ("Northern Star (KLV) Pty Ltd", "Northern Star Resources Ltd", ...) under one key, joint ventures counting for each party. Returns, best match first, each company's or project's key, name, counts (tenements and live ones, drillholes, reports), extent (bbox), the raw names it stands for, and a map link drawing its holdings. Use the key in find_drillholes or map_link.

q.description: A company or project name, or part of one (3+ characters).

name: search_owners
title: Find a company or project
